title: Remote mailbox read on an existing relay locator returned 503 then 409 'federation link changed' with no reconnect action
outcome: The cause of the 503 'native mailbox relay transport/response unavailable' followed by 409 'federation link changed; reconnect and reconcile the original operation' on Windows B's immediate termal_read_mailbox (about 23:53–23:54Z on 2026-10-27, after its bundle sends were accepted) is diagnosed, and either fixed or documented with the recovery path an agent should follow.
acceptance: The trigger for the federation link change observed at about 23:53Z on 2026-10-27 between the central host and Windows B is identified from host evidence (logs or federation state), or the evidence that rules each candidate out is recorded

If the link change was not caused by an operator or restart action, a product fix lands so that an established relay link does not change under an ordinary read, or the condition is bounded and covered by a test
The agent-facing recovery for a 409 'federation link changed' on a read is documented: whether a plain re-read is safe and what reconcile means for a read-only operation
